thesis: The episode introduces Yen Liow, founder and managing partner of Aravot Global, a fundamental global equity firm based in New York that manages long-short and long-only products. Liow discusses his background, including his early interest in business, his time at Bain & Company, and his 13-year tenure at Ziff Brothers Investments where he learned about process, training, and a culture of framework thinking.
